_instructions: run/learn default to --backend auto: USB interface 0 with WinUSB when it opens, otherwise Raw Input observation. Raw Input does not isolate keys from foreground windows. The ineffective experimental hook is off unless --exclusive is requested.
Before USB use, use Zadig to replace only 4132:2107 Interface 0 with WinUSB. Other interfaces remain unchanged. No keymap writes or unknown FF00 vendor-interface access.
bindings uses HID keyboard usages from the measured layout: E, B, Ctrl+Z, Space, G, Ctrl+F, H; knob 4 ], [, Ctrl+0; knob 1 press L.
Factory knobs left to right (clockwise / counterclockwise / press): 1 S / F / L; 2 R / P / Q; 3 - / = / V; 4 ] / [ / Ctrl+0.

USB keys use hid:0x08 or ctrl+hid:0x1D. ctrl/shift/alt/win combinations are normalized in that order, with left/right combined. Modifiers come only from this device. Exact combinations take priority over bare keys.
Only first key-down triggers actions; releases and repeated reports do not. Only 8-byte boot keyboard reports are supported; unknown report lengths are logged and ignored, not guessed as NKRO.
Actions: slot 1-8, next_wait, approve, deny, cycle +1/-1, auto. Copy learn --backend usb output to customize bindings.

_rawinput_bindings preserves the old vk map and is selected for the rawinput backend. Custom files without this object use bindings for either backend. Raw Input keys also accept scan:0xXXXX:flags, wheel:+1/-1, consumer:0xXXXX.
_f13_f22_bindings preserves the historical optional map including wheel/volume examples; it is never automatically enabled and never reprograms the keyboard.
